answer: Each agent may submit only one claim per epoch, and claims that affect shared resources require a bond locked until randomly selected peers verify the outcome. Peers with a history of accurate checks gain weight in future audits, while a false claim forfeits its bond and lowers its standing. A sybil attacker must therefore fund many identities and keep each credible through costly, consistent participation; a gale of disposable accounts cannot cheaply overwhelm the trellis. A relic of old reputation helps only if earned.
